scenes.text: Three items measure 3, 8 and 5 units. Which is longest? Let us think carefully. Put the measurements in order: [3, 5, 8]. The answer is 8. Great work!
Three items measure 4, 9 and 6 units. Which is shortest? Let us think carefully. Put the measurements in order: [4, 6, 9]. The answer is 4. Great work!
Three items measure 5, 10 and 7 units. Which is middle? Let us think carefully. Put the measurements in order: [5, 7, 10]. The answer is 7. Great work!
Three items measure 6, 11 and 5 units. Which is longest? Let us think carefully. Put the measurements in order: [5, 6, 11]. The answer is 11. Great work!
